i1.text: Aisha can now set your reminders for you.

i2.text: Here are four ways she helps you stay on top of your money.

c1q.text: A weekly reminder to tag your payments.

c1a.text: Untagged payments pile up. On your home screen, a new card offers a tagging reminder.

c1b.text: Or just ask Aisha. Remind me to tag my transactions every Friday at six p.m.

c1c.text: Done. Every Friday at six, Wavvy reminds you to tag.

c2q.text: Number two. Never miss a bill.

c2a.text: Tell Aisha about the bill. Remind me to pay rent of eighteen thousand shillings on the fifth of every month.

c2b.text: She doesn't guess. She asks when you'd like to be alerted.

c3q.text: Number three. You choose the alerts.

c3a.text: Answer, two days before, and one day before.

c3b.text: Your rent reminder is saved, with an alert on the due date too.

c4q.text: And number four. Check and tidy your reminders.

c4a.text: Ask, what bill reminders do I have? Aisha lists them all.

c4b.text: She even spots a duplicate rent reminder, and deletes it when you say yes.

c4c.text: Change a time just by asking. Move my Netflix reminder to eight p.m.

c4d.text: Everything shows up in Bill Reminders. Your tagging reminder is in Settings, under Notifications.

o1.text: Open Wavvy Wallet, tap Chat, and let Aisha remind you.
